objective: Test whether two independent repeat outcomes on the same intervention reduce false causal-change alarms while preserving actual structural-change learning versus exact fully fitted controls.
hypothesis: Two matching contradictions to a high-confidence currently retained causal prediction are more reliable evidence of structural change than a single low-likelihood observation, but they may lose to a full posterior change-point filter.
source: Six public binary intervention variables; 40 signed XOR3 original rules plus 120 signed XOR3-and-AND2 composite rules. Real observed consequence follows evaluator hidden rule and independent SHA-derived 15-percent label noise. The exact structural family, change time, hidden rule and noise are source-only.
parent_rule_ids: All 20 signed-XOR3 rule indices with sign=0, indexed 0,2,...,38
prior: 7/8 uniformly among 40 familiar rules, 1/8 uniformly among 120 composite rules
single_surprise_rule: After the old prefix, if an actual new observation has predictive likelihood below 0.18 under the current model, reinitialize the candidate posterior and reprocess only challenge observations accumulated to that event; one reset maximum. No source phase label given to estimator.
paired_confirmation_rule: For each consecutive same-action replicate pair, before incorporating either observation, require old-posterior prediction >=0.80 for one outcome, both observed outcomes equal the other outcome, and no prior reset. Then reinitialize the posterior and reprocess all challenge observations accumulated to that pair, one reset maximum.
fixed_hazard: Prequential exact 160-rule posterior with per-observation renewal hazard 1/48 toward original mixture prior, including during old-prefix fitting.
controls: Sliding last 16 observed outcomes exact Bayesian
Fixed hazard exact Bayesian 1/48 on identical public evidence
Privileged source-phase oracle reset (upper-bound descriptive only)
held_policy: Read-only unobserved 12 distinct actions outside both old and challenge source actions. Posterior predictive causal label (noise-free rule truth); predict 1 only if probability strictly above 0.5, else 0.
evidence: All estimators receive the same 40 actual action-outcome observations, no counterfactuals or unseen held labels; repeat outcomes are independent draws at identical actions. All 240 cases use new SHA namespaces unrelated to ENERGY31.

frozen_success.new_change_vs_single: Paired confirmation must improve held label accuracy by at least 3 percentage points in BOTH changed scenarios separately
frozen_success.false_alarm: Paired confirmation must produce alarms in <=10 percent of stationary streams
frozen_success.full_bayes: Paired confirmation must match or exceed fixed hazard held accuracy in EACH of three scenarios
frozen_success.stationary_retention: Paired confirmation must achieve >=95 percent held accuracy on stationary streams

scope: Synthetic development only. No original/protected first-use, no Yggdrasil native checkpoint action, no merge, no active research loop, controller, schedule or accepted source changes.
